title: Features base: typed feature list, overrides table, evaluation, admin toggles
description:
Build the reusable base for feature toggles. Decisions below were made by the owner on 2026-11-20 (Plannotator thread "Features base and own Pluggy keys"); do not reopen them.

Naming: call it "features" everywhere in code, tables and UI. Never "flags": in the client "flag" already means transaction colour flags (FlagsPane, domain/flagLabels).

Decided:
- A feature is defined in a typed list in code in shared/ (key, description, default boolean). Admin shows that list; nothing creates features at runtime. A key in the database that is no longer in the list is ignored.
- Values are on/off only.
- One table for all features: feature key, user (nullable = "everyone"), value, changed-by user, changed-at. Resolution order: user override, else everyone value, else the default in code.
- The API enforces; the client only shows or hides. Evaluate in handlers and Temporal activities only (workflow files run in the Temporal sandbox and cannot import a DB-backed barrel). Read the database per check, no cache, like requireUser does for role.
- The client gets its own evaluated values from a small endpoint, refetched when the app regains focus. No push, no polling loop.
- Admin: BOTH views. A new Features page (pick a feature: an "everyone" switch plus the users list with a toggle each, showing inherited vs overridden) AND per-user feature toggles inside the existing Users page (admin/src/pages/Users.tsx).
- No history table; who/when on each row is enough.
- Out of scope: groups, percentages, attribute rules, variants, budgets as subjects, CLI/MCP exposure of admin operations beyond what ADMIN_EXPOSE already does for jobs.

First feature to register: 'shared-pluggy-key', default off ("may connect and sync banks with the installation's shared Pluggy keys"). Only register it here; enforcing it belongs to the next task.

Follow AGENTS.md "Adding an endpoint" and "Adding a client screen or feature" exactly (contracts in shared/src/contracts/features, new api feature dir api/src/features with index.ts barrel, catalog entry, access.test.ts and catalog-outputs.test.ts samples, migration numbering >= 0103 additive). Existing admin-only pattern to mirror: api/src/user/admin-users-routes.ts and shared/src/contracts/user/admin-users.ts.
notes:
shared + api done on tk/budget-wvm: shared/src/features.ts (typed list, resolveFeature), contracts in shared/src/contracts/features, migration 0103_feature_overrides.sql + signature, api/src/features (isEnabled, GET /features, /admin/features set/clear everyone + user). api suite 1124 pass. Shared Postgres :5432 is down on this machine, so tests ran against this repo's compose Postgres :55432 via BUDGET_TEST_PG_BASE. Next: client hook, admin SPA views.
All done on tk/budget-wvm (2 commits). client: getMyFeatures in client/src/profile/api.ts + useFeatures() in client/src/state/useFeatures.ts (refetch on focus). admin: Features page (admin/src/pages/Features.tsx) and per-user toggles in Users page (admin/src/featureControls.tsx). task typecheck / lint / test / admin:build all exit 0 (shared 72, api 1124, client 1148 pass, 0 fail). Shared Postgres :5432 was down: DB tests and screenshots used this repo's compose Postgres :55432; it is stopped again, my test DBs dropped, leases released. Screenshots attached.
Rework for review comment t-mwp5n1jd-6k71no (commits a604011, fd6df96). Features now carry a required group (shared-pluggy-key: Banks), returned by the admin list. Admin: a user's features are a dropdown in every user list (summary button -> popover with filter box focused on open, group headings, switch + inherited/overridden + who/when + Inherit; Escape and outside click close it). Features page is a grouped, filterable list with the Everyone switch; #/features/<key> shows one feature's users with an 'Overridden only' filter. Screenshots ev-4dc62b, ev-e832a3, ev-7c39ed, ev-5dc356 were taken with a LOCAL UNCOMMITTED fixture of 8 features in 3 groups (7 demo entries added to shared/src/features.ts, reverted before the final test run); the committed list still has only shared-pluggy-key. typecheck/lint/test/admin:build exit 0 (shared 72, api 1124, client 1148, admin 16 pass). Postgres :5432 still down, used compose :55432 again; stopped, DBs dropped, leases released.
Approved by owner 2026-11-20. Typed feature list with groups in shared/src/features.ts ('shared-pluggy-key', Banks, default off); migration 0103 feature_overrides (everyone + per-user values, who/when); api/src/features (isEnabled: user > everyone > default; admin operations behind requireAdmin; GET /features); client useFeatures hook; admin Features page (grouped, filterable) and per-user features dropdown on Users. Merged to main, not pushed. Validation by the agent: typecheck, lint, admin build, tests (shared 72, api 1124, client 1148, admin 16) on compose Postgres :55432; not run on :5432, test:e2e not run. Evidence: ev-4dc62b, ev-e832a3, ev-7c39ed, ev-5dc356, ev-6aba37.
acceptance_criteria: 1) shared/ exports a typed feature list (key, description, default) with 'shared-pluggy-key' default off, with a test. 2) Migration >=0103 creates the overrides table + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES entry. 3) api/src/features exposes isEnabled(db, feature, userId) resolving user override > everyone value > code default, unit + DB tested. 4) Admin-only operations (requireAdmin, 403 for non-admin asserted in access.test.ts) list features with everyone value and per-user overrides, set/clear the everyone value, set/clear a user override; each write stores who and when. 5) A signed-in user can fetch their own evaluated features; the Expo client exposes them through a hook and refetches on focus. 6) Admin SPA: a Features page (per feature: everyone switch + users with toggles) and feature toggles on each user in the Users page. 7) task typecheck, task lint, task test pass; screenshots of both admin views attached as evidence.
